## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Position sizing follows risk-rules.md; headline P&L assumes $25K+ account for full qty (28 contracts requires ~$25K per risk rules). At $1K paper account, realized P&L is ~14% of headline due to 50% per-trade risk cap.
2. **Sample bias:** In-sample period covers 16 months (2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2) with 6 quarters; selection bias risk high as parameters were not re-optimized per quarter; overfit likely given quarterly P&L instability (2025-Q1:-$1300.5, 2025-Q2:+$769.79, 2025-Q3:-$1134.66, 2025-Q4:-$1246.16, 2026-Q1:+$1548.89, 2026-Q2:-$101.59).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out test executed; Stage-1 is in-sample BS-synthetic).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (Stage-1 used BS-synthetic option pricing per engine note; real OPRA fills may differ significantly, especially for ITM/OTM 0DTE).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Regime shift: Performance collapses in low-volatility environments (2025-Q3,-$1134.66) and recovery regimes (2026-Q2,-$101.59).
   - Concentration risk: Top 5 days = 999.0% of P&L (per Stage-1 top5_pct), meaning ordinary days net lose.
   - False positives: BS-synthetic overestimates ITM 0DTE entry premiums (L23), causing premature stop triggers.
6. **Concentration:** Top 5 days = 999.0% of total P&L (Stage-1 top5_pct=999.0), indicating extreme reliance on few profitable days; 2/6 quarters positive (33.3% hit rate).
